notes.title: ROSE Is Now in Early Access!
notes.content:
[p][/p][p]🎉 [b]ROSE is now available in Early Access![/b]
Starting today, you can dive into ROSE – an atmospheric puzzle-platformer that follows the emotional journey of a young girl in a war-torn world.[/p][p]🧠 Each puzzle holds clues to her past and future. This story, told more through visuals than words, aims to reveal the silent screams within.[/p][hr][/hr][p]🎮 [b]What’s included right now?[/b][/p][list][*][p]The first chapter is fully playable[/p][/*][*][p]Core gameplay mechanics are functional[/p][/*][*][p]We will shape the game with your feedback during Early Access[/p][/*][/list][p]📣 [b]Your feedback means everything to us.[/b]
Please share your thoughts on our Steam Community page or join the discussion on our Discord server![/p][p]🔗 [b]Play now:[/b]
👉 [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2657160/ROSE/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: ROSE - New Update Released!
notes.content: [p]🌹 ROSE Update Released![/p][p]Our latest update brings several important fixes and improvements:[/p][p] 🛠️ Fixes[/p][p]- The **crash issue** occurring during gameplay has been resolved.  [/p][p]- The **wood breaking mechanic** now works correctly.[/p][p]🎨 Improvements[/p][p]- Various **UI (User Interface)** bugs have been fixed.  [/p][p]- The **lighting system** has been enhanced to create a more immersive atmosphere.[/p][p]Your feedback is always valuable to us!  [/p][p]Enjoy the game! 🌟[/p]
